sql.processStep.getAllForCompany: select ps.id, ps.process_step_name, ps.company_id, ps.archived, ps.date_created, ps.date_updated, ps.created_by_id, ps.modified_by_id from flow.process_step ps where ps.company_id = :companyId and ps.archived is not true
sql.processStep.get: select ps.id, ps.process_step_name, ps.company_id, ps.archived, ps.date_created, ps.date_updated, ps.created_by_id, ps.modified_by_id, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(cfGroups))) FROM ( SELECT cfgt.id, cfgt.group_name as "groupName", cfgt.object_type_id as "objectTypeId", cfgt.archived, cfgt.group_order as "groupOrder", cfgt.process_step_id as "processStepId", cfgt.process_step_custom_field_type_id as "processStepCustomFieldTypeId", coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(customFields))) FROM ( SELECT cfg.id, cfg.custom_field_group_type_id as "customFieldGroupTypeId", cfg.custom_field_id as "customFieldId", cfg.ancillary_custom_field_group_id as "ancillaryCustomFieldGroupId", cfg.field_order as "fieldOrder", cfg.archived, cf.field_name as "fieldName" FROM flow.custom_field_group cfg inner join flow.custom_field cf on cf.id = cfg.custom_field_id WHERE cfg.custom_field_group_type_id = cfgt.id AND cfg.archived is not true) customFields), '[]') AS "customFields" FROM flow.custom_field_group_type cfgt WHERE cfgt.process_step_id = ps.id AND cfgt.archived is not true) cfGroups), '[]') AS custom_field_group_types from flow.process_step ps where ps.id = :id
sql.processStep.delete: update flow.process_step set archived = true, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_updated = now() where id = :id
sql.processStep.update: update flow.process_step set modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_updated = now(), process_step_name = :name where id = :id;
